clips.notes: standing tall and kind: slow breathing with one deeper breath (the chest and the half-open wings rise with it), weight shift with the hips leading, looks a little away and back (neck leads), a small content nod; the wings breathe (shoulders of the wings lift, the primaries open and close a little, the right wing a few frames behind the left) and once rouse their feathers; hair and sash drift; irregular blinks

high in the air (root 0.55 up, in the clip): two slow powerful wing beats of 1.2 s; down-stroke with the wing fully extended and the primaries spread, up-stroke with the wing partly folded and the fan closed; wing1 -> 2 -> 3 -> prim each lag their parent, the feathers twist with the air; the body rises on every down-stroke (root bob 0.016) and the chest crunches; arms float, legs hang relaxed (toes pointed, the right leg trailing) and swing late; looks down at the page

from hover height (0.55, same pose as hover frame 0) comes down in 4.2 s with three big slow wing beats (down-strokes centred at 0.33 / 1.53 / 2.73 s: the story's wing_flap sfx at 0.4 / 1.6 / 2.8), each down-stroke slows the fall; then the wings flare up and forward to brake (primaries spread, body leans back, legs reach down, toes first), touches down at the `land` marker, the knees absorb, a last soft push of the wings, the feathers settle; ends standing, wings open (= fold_wings frame 0)

from the open wings of the landing: a breath and a little lift and spread (anticipation), then folds the wings behind the back with overlapping action (wing1 leads, forearm, hand and the closing fan follow a few frames later), shakes the feathers into place (a quick decaying ruffle with a shrug), settles; holds folded (RIG.md §4 fold: tips at the knees)

calm noble walk (~82 steps/min), wings folded: tall chest, soft hip bob, chest counter-turn, restrained arm swing with lagging forearms, head steady; the folded wings bounce a little late with each step, hair and sash swing late

EXTRA (not in CONTRACT §4): from standing with folded wings, steps the left foot forward and goes down on the right knee (knee on the page), lifting the folded wings a little; ends = kneel_talk frame 0. Play it before kneel_talk (kneel_talk is a loop and cannot itself go down)

on the right knee (knee and tucked toes on the page, left foot planted forward), folded wings lifted and swept back so the back foot stays clear of the feathers; leans in and talks warmly: left forearm on the left knee, right hand opening palm up toward the child on the stressed syllables, nods, head tilt; jaw in an irregular syllable rhythm (lip sync overrides it); slow blinks

from the kneel (kneel_talk frame 0): leans forward, pushes up on the left knee with the left hand, rises into a lunge (back foot on its toes), brings the right foot up beside the left, straightens; wings go from the lifted kneel fold back to the standing fold; holds standing (= talk frame 0 stance)

standing talk with open, generous gestures, wings folded: both hands open outward palms up (a giving gesture), then the right hand alone sweeps out, the left comes to the chest; nods on the stressed syllables, weight shift; jaw in an irregular syllable rhythm (lip sync overrides it); the folded wings lift a little with the big gesture

from the standing talk stance: a small dip, the right arm sweeps up and points to heaven (overshoot and settle), the chest lifts and he looks up after his hand, holds the look, then looks back at the child with a kind smile while the arm stays up; the folded wings lift a little with the gesture; holds

the golden trumpet in his right hand at his side: a little dip, then lifts it high above his head, bell to the sky, chest up, chin up, a proud smile; the folded wings open to half with overlapping action as the arm goes up; overshoot and settle; holds (blow_trumpet then brings it to the lips)

the trumpet at his lips (mouthpiece on the lips, RIG.md §4 hold, kept in head space), bell up and forward: two phrases per 4 s loop: a big breath (chest and shoulders rise, head back, wings gather), then he blows (`blow` = sound starts), leaning back so the bell lifts, the chest slowly empties; the wings flare open with each phrase (from half to almost spread, with overlapping action and a feather shiver) and relax; left arm out for balance

starts as blow_trumpet frame 0 (trumpet at the lips); lowers the trumpet to his side, the wings dip and gather (anticipation) then sweep open to a majestic full spread raised a little above the rest pose (overlapping wing1 -> prim, overshoot, the feathers settle), chest up, chin up, both arms slightly out from the body, palms forward; holds

wings wide and breathing slowly, the trumpet put away: the right hand comes to his heart, rests there, then opens palm toward the viewer (forward and a little out), holds, and returns to the heart; a slow warm nod and head tilt; jaw in a syllable rhythm for the line (lip sync overrides it); slow blinks

friendly goodbye to the viewer: the right hand up beside the head waving from the elbow, a smile with a head tilt and a weight shift; the half-open wings wave along a little (tips flutter late); jaw syllables for the line (lip sync overrides it)

from the half-open standing pose (wave): crouches (knees bend, arms swing back, wings rise high), springs with a huge down-stroke (feet leave the page at `takeoff`), then two more beats, faster (0.9 s), rising and drifting back toward the gate; looks up, joyful; legs trail with pointed toes; root rises to 1.2 (and 0.18 back) in the clip; ends in the air (off the top of the page)

rootTravelNote: hover / fly_down / fly_up carry their height on the `root` bone inside the clip (fly_up also 0.18 back toward the gate); the director adds no height. All other clips keep root at 0.
propsNote: gabriel/trumpet is posed for in the clips whose `props` list it (raise_trumpet, blow_trumpet, spread_wings); hidden otherwise. gabriel/sword is always shown.
